notes: Borough accepted DCA's obligation of 16 units present need and 128 units prospective need via binding resolution R-25-66 (January 7, 2025). VLA results in Fourth Round RDP=0 and Unmet Need=128. Borough must address 25% of 128-unit obligation (32 units) with realistic zoning/redevelopment; identifies 14.5 credits toward that requirement with remaining via Downtown Overlay Zone and Municipal Set-Aside Ordinance. Prior Round (34 units) satisfied by David F. Roche Apartments. Third Round (RDP 81 of 295) satisfied by Roche Apartments, Schraalenburgh Senior Housing, and Landmark Dumont LLC. Combined Unmet Need across all rounds (prior, 3rd, and 4th) is 209 units, addressed by Downtown Overlay Zone and set-aside ordinance.

sites.proposed_zoning: Special overlay zone to be adopted

sites.quote: Fermano Builders, LLC has proposed to erect a nine (9) unit multi-family townhome development with two (2) affordable units at 219 Washington Ave (B. 908, L. 22).
sites.notes: Infill bonus applies; 2.5 total credits. Requires 'D' variance for density; Borough will adopt special overlay zone.

sites.quote: The Borough adopted an overlay district on March 6, 2018 over a large portion of the downtown area within the B2 Zone… The downtown overlay zone requires an affordable housing set-aside of 15 percent of all residential units, where affordable units will be for rent, or 20 percent of all residential units, where affordable units will be for sale.
sites.notes: Approximately 52 acres of B2 zone. Maximum density 20 du/ac (24 du/ac in limited sections of ~6 acres). Primary unmet need mechanism; expected to generate ~150-200 affordable units at full build-out. No specific block/lot — zone-wide.

sites.quote: The Borough also adopted an ordinance on March 3, 2018 which required that any multi-family development with a density of 6 dwelling units per acre or higher shall provide an affordable housing set-aside at a rate of 15 percent, where affordable units will be for rent, or 20 percent, where affordable units will be for sale.
sites.notes: Borough-wide MSO. No block/lot applicable. Supplemental mechanism.
